newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian OTC stocks mixed in week to July 4.
newsitem.headline: Croatian OTC stocks mixed in week to July 4.

text.p: Croatian stocks traded mixed in shrinking over-the-counter activity in the week to July 4, the Varazdin Securities Market reported on Monday.
Weekly volume in regular trade fell to 5,906 units from nearly 21,000 a week earlier as smaller packages in 24 firms were traded. Turnover shrank to 1.6 million from 5.3 million kuna.
Nine stocks fell, nine rose and six were flat, pushing the leading seven-stock VIN index down to end at 9,936 points, 0.66 percent lower on a weekly basis.
A package of 445 paid, and subscribed but unpaid-for, shares in Cakovec-based firm Tegra went for 39,249 kuna.
Brokers also reported direct deals with 755 shares in seven other firms, bringing total turnover to 1.77 million kuna.

Gainers were led by brewery Karlovacka Pivovara, in which Chile's Compania Cervecerias Unidas has a majority stake. It added 62.16 percent to 600 kuna on volume of 56 shares. The brewery closed at 588 kuna on the Zagreb Stock Exchange.

It was followed by Ericsson Tesla, rising 31.71 percent to end at 270 kuna. The electronics manufacturer was also the most active issue with more than 2,200 shares sold, accounting for 27 percent of the total weekly trade.
Construction firm Industrogradnja, losing 11.11 percent to 800 kuna with four shares sold, was the biggest decliner.
